guideName: Leonida Legend — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Tracker
listNote: All 55 official PS5 trophies. Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Guide text is original to this guide and cites its sources per trophy.
sourcesNote: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles published the same 55 names, descriptions and grades; the two agree on every entry. Guide text: our own, written from the official descriptions.

trophies.guide: The platinum itself. It pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all on your account, so there is nothing separate to hunt: work the roadmap stages in order, keep the five missable trophies in sight during the story, and let this be the last trophy you earn.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies on this list
Follow the roadmap stages 1 to 7 in order
The platinum unlocks automatically once trophy 54 lands

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the game. Simply start a new game and play the introduction through to its end; it cannot be skipped past or locked out, and it doubles as the tutorial for movement, driving and your phone.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names the mission. Guide text: our own.
steps: Start a new game
Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end
The trophy pops as the mission completes

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission that belongs to Chapter 1. Chapter trophies are pure story progress: follow the main markers on the map, ignore side content until the chapter closes if you want it quickly, and the trophy lands as the chapter ends. Nothing in Chapter 1 can be missed permanently.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.
steps: Follow the main story markers through Chapter 1
Complete the chapter's final mission
The trophy pops at the chapter break

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the main story. Keep pushing the main mission chain after the Chapter 1 break; the trophy is automatic when the chapter's last mission ends. The name is censored on PlayStation itself, so it appears here exactly as published.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: Official name (including its asterisks), description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own.
steps: Continue the main story into Chapter 2
Complete the chapter's final mission
The trophy pops at the chapter break

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the main story. By now the map and your contact list are much wider, but the requirement has not changed: clear the chapter's main missions in order and the trophy unlocks at the chapter break. Side strands can wait for the clean-up stage of the roadmap.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own.
steps: Continue the main story into Chapter 3
Complete the chapter's final mission
The trophy pops at the chapter break

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the last numbered chapter before the endgame. Before you start its final missions, sweep up the missable trophies flagged in this guide, because the finale sequence is the natural point of no return for free-roam detours.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Missable warning: our own, from the chapter structure in the official descriptions. Guide text: our own.
steps: Continue the main story into Chapter 4
Grab any remaining missable trophies before the finale
Complete the chapter's final mission

trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the story: complete the final mission after Chapter 4. Stock up on armour, ammo and snacks before you accept it, and make a manual save in a separate slot first so any choice-based trophy can be revisited from that save afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.
steps: Finish Chapter 4
Save in a spare slot and stock up before the finale
Complete the final mission

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies like this one are awarded automatically when their named mission ends, whenever in the story you reach it; just keep following the main chain and it will be offered to you.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names the mission. Guide text: our own.
steps: Progress the main story until Breakfast Run is offered
Complete the mission
The trophy pops at the mission results screen

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a set-piece heist inside the main campaign, so it cannot be missed: reach it through normal story progress, finish every phase, and the trophy is awarded as the heist wraps up.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names the mission. Guide text: our own.
steps: Progress the main story until The Cartel Heist is offered
Complete every phase of the heist
The trophy pops as the mission ends

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies it is handed out automatically at the end of its mission, which the main story chain leads you to in order.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names the mission. Guide text: our own.
steps: Progress the main story until Child's Play is offered
Complete the mission
The trophy pops at the mission results screen

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Follow the main mission chain until Headliners appears, finish it, and the trophy unlocks at the results screen. No preparation or side condition is attached to it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names the mission. Guide text: our own.
steps: Progress the main story until Headliners is offered
Complete the mission
The trophy pops at the mission results screen

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. It is part of the main chain, so normal story progress delivers it; finish the mission and the trophy follows. Note the airport connection: the separate Catch Me If You Can trophy also concerns VCIA and is missable, so read its guide before you leave the area for good.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names the mission and location. Guide text: our own.
steps: Progress the main story until VCIA Takedown is offered
Complete the mission
Before moving on, check the Catch Me If You Can guide for the same location

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Another automatic mission trophy: reach it through the main chain, finish the operation, and it unlocks at the results screen.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names the mission. Guide text: our own.
steps: Progress the main story until Operation Savage Glory is offered
Complete the mission
The trophy pops at the mission results screen

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's completion counter. This is the long tail of the platinum: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and exploration all feed the percentage. Track it in the game's stats screen, clear the roadmap stages in order, and use this tracker's checklist to see which categories still owe you percentage points.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.
steps: Finish the story and all stranger strands
Clear activities and collectibles stage by stage
Check the in-game completion stat until it reads 100%

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts in total. Stunt jumps and stunt events across Leonida all count toward the same tally, so weave them into normal travel instead of grinding at the end: whenever a ramp or jump marker is on your route, take it. The in-game stats screen shows your running total.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; the count of 250 is in the official description; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own.
steps: Attempt stunt jumps and stunt events as you travel
Watch the stunt total in the stats screen
Reach 250 completed stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type in the game once — the official list counts 9 types. You do not need to win or finish well, just start each type at least once: races, drone races, shooting range, fishing, arcade games and the rest. Do it early, because several other trophies build on these same activities.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; activity-type count: PSNProfiles trophy data for this list. Guide text: our own.
steps: Open the map legend and note every activity icon type
Start one activity of each of the 9 types
The trophy pops when the last new type is tried

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal every Shooting Range challenge — 42 of them in the official count. Learn each weapon lane's target pattern at bronze pace first, then chase gold once the pattern is muscle memory. Accuracy beats speed in most lanes, so slow down, use cover-free standing lines, and replay a lane immediately while it is fresh.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; challenge count of 42: PSNProfiles trophy data for this list. Guide text: our own.
steps: Unlock the Shooting Range and clear each lane once
Replay lanes until every one shows a gold medal
All 42 challenges gold earns the trophy

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations in the official count. A win at each distinct location is what matters, not total wins, so travel the circuit once, learn each course's tight gates on a practice run, then take the win before moving to the next location.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; location count of 14: PSNProfiles trophy data for this list. Guide text: our own.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race start point
Win the race, then move to the next location
Win at all 14 locations

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeats of the same race do not add to the count, so keep a simple note of which race starts you have already won and always pick a fresh one. Bring a competitive vehicle for each class and learn the first corner — most street races are decided there.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; the count of 20 different races is in the official description; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own.
steps: Enter races from map markers across Leonida
Win, and note the race as done
Reach 20 distinct race wins

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Out-fish Cal in one of his fishing challenges. Fishing challenges are timed catch contests: use the best rod and bait you have unlocked, cast where the water is active, and prioritise steady medium catches over one risky trophy fish. If Cal wins, the challenge can simply be retried.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names Cal and the fishing challenge. Guide text: our own.
steps: Unlock fishing and meet Cal's challenge
Catch steadily for the full timer
Finish with a better haul than Cal

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game from start to completion at any arcade cabinet in the world. Pick the shortest game on the cabinet, play it through to its end screen rather than quitting mid-game, and the trophy unlocks. It also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in a shop or arcade
Start a game and play it to its end screen
The trophy pops on completion

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand by completing his final mission. Contact strands unlock as the story introduces each character; work Andy's markers whenever they appear and this trophy lands at the end of his last job. Stranger and contact strands also feed Strangers & Freaks and the 100% counter.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names Andy. Guide text: our own.
steps: Meet Andy and open his mission strand
Complete each of Andy's missions as they appear
Finish his final mission

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand by completing his final mission. Keep Kenton's markers in your rotation as they appear through the story; the trophy is awarded at the end of his last mission, and the strand counts toward both Strangers & Freaks progress and 100% completion.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names Kenton. Guide text: our own.
steps: Meet Kenton and open his mission strand
Complete each of Kenton's missions as they appear
Finish his final mission

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand by completing his final mission. Billy's jobs appear as his strand unlocks; clear them in order and the trophy pops when his story closes. As with every contact strand, finishing it also moves Strangers & Freaks and the completion percentage.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names Billy. Guide text: our own.
steps: Meet Billy and open his mission strand
Complete each of Billy's missions as they appear
Finish his final mission

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. A strand means the whole chain for one stranger, not a single job: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each provide one, and the remaining strands come from strangers met while exploring. Finishing the named contacts' final missions first is the fastest route to eight.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; the strand count of 8 is in the official description; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own.
steps: Finish the Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone strands
Pick up stranger strands while exploring Leonida
Complete 8 strands in total

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand by completing his final mission. Work Randy's markers as they appear; his last job closes the strand, awards this trophy, and adds one completed strand toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names Randy. Guide text: our own.
steps: Meet Randy and open his mission strand
Complete each of Randy's missions as they appear
Finish his final mission

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by completing his final mission. Clear Tyrone's jobs in order as the strand unfolds; the trophy lands at the end of the last one and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks and 100% completion.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names Tyrone. Guide text: our own.
steps: Meet Tyrone and open his mission strand
Complete each of Tyrone's missions as they appear
Finish his final mission

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots spread across Leonida. Spots sit at scenic overlooks — headlands, rooftops, quiet beaches — and each one only needs a single meditation. Sweep them region by region while doing The Goodtime State exploration so no spot is left isolated on the map.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; spot count of 18: PSNProfiles trophy data for this list. Guide text: our own.
steps: Find a meditation spot at a scenic overlook
Meditate there once
Repeat at all 18 spots across Leonida

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Complete Bret's hunting request by tracking and hunting the unique animal he sends you after. Follow his strand until the unique hunt is offered, track the animal using the hunt prompts, and bring it down cleanly. It is a one-animal job, not a hunting marathon.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names Bret and the unique animal. Guide text: our own.
steps: Open Bret's hunting strand
Accept the unique animal hunt
Track and hunt the animal, then report back to Bret

trophies.guide: Finish any 3 complete Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden pickups all over Leonida, grouped into themed sets; a set only counts when every card in it is found. Focus on the three shortest sets first, sweep them alongside exploration, and check the collections menu to see exactly which cards each set still needs.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; the set count of 3 is in the official description; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own.
steps: Open the collections menu and pick the three shortest card sets
Collect every card in those sets
The trophy pops when the third set is completed

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 different locations. WAiNK spots are marked places around Leonida where the action can be performed; each distinct location counts once. Treat it like the other location sweeps: clear them district by district while exploring, and let the stats screen confirm your running total.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; the count of 100 locations is in the official description; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own.
steps: Find a WAiNK location marker
Perform the action there
Repeat at 100 distinct locations

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's challenges. Challenges are the short scored tasks scattered through activities and free roam; they accumulate naturally while you work the other activity trophies. If you finish the story short of 50, open the challenges list and clear the quickest remaining ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; the count of 50 is in the official description; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own.
steps: Complete challenges as they appear during activities
Check your challenge total in the stats or challenges menu
Reach 50 completed challenges

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: While playing with your partner character, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely — the stars must fully clear, not just start flashing down. Commit crimes together until four stars show, then break line of sight, swap vehicles away from the search area and wait out the search with your partner still with you.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The 4-star requirement is in the official description. Guide text: our own.
steps: Have your partner with you in free roam
Raise the wanted level to 4 stars together
Escape the search until the wanted level fully clears

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in one unbroken wanted sequence: the wanted level must never fully clear between shops. Pick three shops close together in one district, rob the first, drive straight to the second while still wanted, then the third, keeping the heat alive the whole way.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The 3-shop, no-drop requirement is in the official description. Guide text: our own.
steps: Scout three shops close together in one district
Rob the first with your partner and take the wanted level
Rob the second and third before the wanted level clears

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — a vehicle is discovered the first time you get in and drive it. Steal broadly as you travel: every new model you sit in adds one. Wealthy districts, ports and the airport are dense with distinct models, and registering vehicles for On the Spot overlaps with this hunt.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; the count of 100 is in the official description; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own.
steps: Enter and drive vehicles you have not used before
Check the discovered count in the stats or vehicles menu
Reach 100 distinct vehicles discovered

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one activation of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aiming ability. Set it up deliberately: start a fight against a group of at least five enemies standing fairly close, weaken none of them, trigger Combat Focus and work target to target without wasting shots on cover. Gang operations and robberies give reliable groups.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The 5-in-one-use requirement is in the official description. Guide text: our own.
steps: Find a group of at least 5 enemies
Trigger Combat Focus once
Take down 5 enemies before the effect ends

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — flagged because it hangs on VCIA, the airport, which the story visits for VCIA Takedown: an unscheduled departure means leaving by air outside any scripted flight, and the clean chance comes while the airport is open to you around that mission. Steal an aircraft at VCIA and take off in free roam rather than waiting for a story flight. If you finish the story without it, check whether the airport is still enterable in free roam before starting a new playthrough.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names VCIA. Missable flag: our own, because the description ties the act to a story-visited location. Guide text: our own.
steps: Reach VCIA during or after VCIA Takedown
Take an aircraft without a scheduled or scripted flight
Lift off from VCIA to make the departure

trophies.guide: The description is a joke with one concrete noun in it: Rhinos, the game's tanks. This trophy is earned around Rhino tanks — get involved with one when military heat or a military location puts a Rhino in front of you, whether that means surviving it, stealing the area it guards or turning it to your use. Because the official text gives no steps, treat any Rhino encounter as the attempt and keep a save before high-heat military fights.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description names only the Rhino; the method here is our own reading of it, stated as such. Guide text: our own.
steps: Raise serious military heat or visit a military location
Engage with the Rhino tank that responds
Complete the encounter with the Rhino involved

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store with zero detection: no alarm raised and no witness completing a call. Go at night, park out of sight, deal quietly with anyone inside before they can react, take the goods and leave before any wanted level forms. If you are spotted, walk away and try another store — the attempt only counts clean.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The no-detection requirement is in the official description. Guide text: our own.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and approach quietly, ideally at night
Rob it without any detection or alarm
Leave the area with no wanted level

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one — a vault only counts if you get away, so plan the exit before you go in: a fast car parked facing out, a route that breaks line of sight, and your partner ready. Spread the five across different banks and let the heat fully clear between jobs.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; the count of 5 is in the official description; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own.
steps: Rob a bank vault
Escape until the wanted level clears
Repeat at 5 bank vaults in total

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape. Armored trucks appear on the roads as armoured cash transport: block one, open the rear doors with force or explosives, grab the cash and lose the wanted level that follows. One successful truck is all the trophy asks for.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.
steps: Find an armored truck in traffic
Stop it and open the rear doors
Take the cash and escape the wanted level

trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida — 52 areas in the official count. Areas register as you enter them, so the efficient play is a full coastal and inland circuit after the map opens, filling any grey patches region by region. Pair the sweep with meditation spots, cards and WAiNK locations so the trips pay off three times.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; area count of 52: PSNProfiles trophy data for this list. Guide text: our own.
steps: Open the full map and note unexplored areas
Travel through each area until it registers
Cover all 52 areas of Leonida

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation run by each gang — 9 gangs in the official count. Every gang holds its own territory and operation type, so keep a note of which gangs you have already hit; hitting the same gang twice does not advance the count. Clear the operation, take what it holds and get out.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; gang count of 9: PSNProfiles trophy data for this list. Guide text: our own.
steps: Find an illegal operation and note which gang runs it
Rob the operation and escape
Repeat until all 9 gangs have been robbed once

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — flagged because it is a small one-off moment tied to Ocean Beach, the game's opening area: go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a beachfront bar and drink it somewhere with the ocean view the description asks for. Do it early, while you are first in the area, rather than assuming the exact spot stays available all game; if the prompt never appears, revisit the beachfront bars at different times of day.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names Ocean Beach. Missable flag: our own caution for a one-off ambient moment. Guide text: our own.
steps: Travel to Ocean Beach
Order a cocktail at a beachfront bar
Drink it facing the ocean view

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — flagged because showroom escapes are usually staged around specific visits: get inside a vehicle showroom, take one of its cars and drive it out through the glass frontage rather than the door. If a story or contact mission takes you into a showroom, do the smash on that visit instead of leaving politely, and keep a save from before the visit in case the moment is one-time.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Missable flag: our own, because the act reads as a staged one-off. Guide text: our own.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom
Take a showroom vehicle
Drive out through the glass in classic style

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete the follow-through the description jokes about — in practice, go to that named alley and play a game there rather than at any other lane. It also registers bowling as an activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description itself names the alley. Guide text: our own.
steps: Travel to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Start a bowling game there
Play it through to the end

trophies.guide: The description points at the partnership between the two protagonists and at being seen: a shared moment that draws a crowd or an audience. Take your partner out in public — busy beachfront and nightlife areas are the natural stage — and use the partner and photo-friendly interactions there. Because the official text is deliberately vague, this guide states plainly that the trigger is read from the description's wording, not confirmed steps.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description is a riddle; the reading above is our own and labelled as such. Guide text: our own.
steps: Bring your partner to a busy public place
Use partner interactions where a crowd can gather
Repeat in other busy spots if the first does not trigger it

trophies.guide: MISSABLE — flagged because it is choice-driven: PlayStation tracks this trophy with a counter that runs to 500, so it is earned by making choices as they are offered through the story and world, and a playthrough that always takes the same safe route can end short. Never skip a dialogue or action choice, vary your answers instead of repeating one, and check the counter in the trophy's progress on the console. Keeping a pre-finale save lets you farm remaining choices if the story ends first.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; tracked count of 500: PSNProfiles trophy data for this list. Missable flag: our own, because the counter depends on choices made along the way. Guide text: our own.
steps: Take every choice the story and world offer
Vary choices instead of repeating a single option
Reach the tracked total of 500 choices

trophies.guide: MISSABLE in spirit — flagged because its shape is fail first, succeed second: the description says the second attempt is the charm, so this is earned by failing at something and then succeeding at the same thing on the retry. The trap is playing too well: if a repeatable challenge, race or job offers a retry, take one deliberate failure early while retries are cheap, then win the second attempt.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description is a riddle; the fail-then-succeed reading is our own and labelled as such. Guide text: our own.
steps: Pick a repeatable race, challenge or job
Fail the first attempt
Succeed at the same attempt on the retry

trophies.guide: The description is the reaction to witnessing something strange, so this is the game's weird-event trophy: explore off the beaten path — remote areas at night are the classic place for it — and investigate any strange sight, light or encounter until the event plays out in front of you. It is a discovery trophy, not a combat one, so stay and watch rather than shooting.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The description is a riddle; the reading above is our own and labelled as such. Guide text: our own.
steps: Explore remote parts of Leonida, including at night
Investigate anything strange you come across
Witness the event through to its end

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, use the melee attack as you pass someone on foot so the hit lands from the vehicle. Ride or drive slowly past a pedestrian on a pavement, time the melee swing as you draw level, and make sure the vehicle is moving — a stationary shove does not read as a drive-by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. The melee drive-by requirement is in the official description. Guide text: our own.
steps: Get in or on a vehicle
Drive slowly past a pedestrian
Land a melee attack from the moving vehicle

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and operations; instead of spending them raw, pass them to the contacts who clean money and let the laundered total build. It is a grind of accumulation, not one big job, so start routing bills through contacts from the first robbery onward.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; the $250,000 figure is in the official description; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and operations
Hand them to contacts who launder money
Reach $250,000 laundered in total

trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 in shops — any shops, any goods. Vehicles, weapons, clothing and services all count toward the same running total, so it arrives naturally if you buy rather than steal your gear. If you are close at the end of the roadmap, one vehicle purchase usually closes the gap.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; the $100,000 figure is in the official description; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own.
steps: Buy gear, vehicles and services in shops as you play
Watch the amount spent in the stats screen
Reach $100,000 spent in total

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in the game — 8 garages in the official count. Garages are bought at their for-sale signs once you have the cash, and they double as vehicle storage for the collection you build for Whip It Good. Save the expensive ones for after the story, when heist money has come in.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; garage count of 8: PSNProfiles trophy data for this list. Guide text: our own.
steps: Find garage properties marked for sale
Buy each one at its sign
Own all 8 garage properties

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. When you take a vehicle you want kept, open the app flow and register it; each distinct vehicle registered adds one. Ten is a small target — register your favourite story vehicles as you go and this finishes long before Whip It Good does.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: PlayStation list as published by Exophase; the count of 10 is in the official description; cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own.
steps: Take a vehicle you want to keep
Register it in the Scooter Bros app
Register 10 vehicles in total
